notes: World Inequality Database (WID) series for Japan. Values are in WID's local-currency current-price units per adult (equal-split adults, age group 992). Extracted from WID bulk data download (wid.world/data/) variable family ptinc (pop=j equal-split, age=992 adults). Thresholds shown are the minimum income to enter the given top percentile group (e.g. p90p100 threshold = P90 cutoff). Median approximated by the p50p100 threshold. Gini series only available for a subset of country/variable combos and may be null. This file combines both pretax_national and posttax_national series for JPN under the 'datasets' key; each entry follows the standard {year, mean, median, gini, percentiles, top_shares, sd_log_income} schema.
